summary: GET /api/auth/me returns HTTP 500: the route declares token: str = Depends(lambda: None), so token is always None and jwt.decode raises.
root_cause: Placeholder dependency never replaced with a real bearer-token extractor; no other router consumes Authorization, and the frontend does not call this endpoint, so it went unnoticed.
recovery: Not yet fixed. Non-blocking for staging smoke (login, knowledge, conversations, stats all 200). Recommended fix: HTTPBearer security dependency returning the decoded payload, and enforce auth on data routers.
prevention: Add negative/positive auth route tests; flag endpoints with lambda dependencies in review.
